verdicts.title: Cohomological properties of the Vietoris--Rips Complex of a Hypercube Graph
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We develop a toric topological framework for studying the cohomology of Vietoris--Rips complexes $VR(Q_n;r)$ of hypercube graphs. Using total domination invariants and spectral methods, we establish general lower bounds on connectivity, which leads to infinite families of counterexamples to Shukla's conjecture, and derive first global upper bounds on coconnectivity.
